subject: Welcome to Match Mate, {{firstName}}

Hello {{firstName}},

Thanks for joining Match Mate. Complete your profile and verify your details to get better matches.

body:
Hello {{firstName}},

Use OTP {{otp}} to verify your email. Expires in {{expiryMinutes}} minutes.

body: Use OTP {{otp}} to verify your phone number. Expires in {{expiryMinutes}} minutes.

body:
Hi {{firstName}},

Use OTP {{otp}} to reset your password. Expires in {{expiryMinutes}} minutes.

subject: You have a new match on Match Mate
body:
Hi {{firstName}},

You matched with {{matchName}}. Open Match Mate and start a conversation.

subject: Your subscription is now active
body:
Hi {{firstName}},

Your {{planName}} plan is active until {{validTill}}.
